annotations.title: Read a battle as a spectator

description: Returns any battle by a token from list_public_battles or its link, as a spectator sees it on the site: battle holds its settings, round, phase, result and each player's army, score, command points and secondary cards; missions the mission each side plays; report its log as the report reads it, oldest first and 200 entries a page: each entry's seq, round, phase, the player id that recorded it (by) and a sentence saying what happened. Pass nextAfter as after for the next page. Practice battles are left out of list_public_battles but still open from their link.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.
